name: Forum of Amity
description: A place on Arcavios with a manor, gardens and duelling stages, where ritual has kept the peace for seven hundred years.

timeline.summary: Shadrix Silverquill founds the Forum of Amity to strengthen the peace formed at the end of the Blood Age.
timeline.quote: the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

timeline.summary: Abigale opens the friends' shared scribing-board correspondence from the Forum of Amity.
timeline.quote: They're coming through to you in my very own handwriting.

timeline.summary: After a tea ceremony ends on a bitter note, Killian steps up as a second for a ritual duel at the Forum.
timeline.quote: the ceremony ended on a bitter note, and at the Forum of Amity, there was but one recourse for bitterness.

timeline.summary: Scriv is created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a delicate diplomatic agreement and takes over monitoring its other contracts.
timeline.quote: Scriv is an inkling initially created at the Forum of Amity to moderate and enforce a particularly delicate diplomatic agreement.

relations.note: He founded the Forum of Amity.
relations.quote: the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

pages_say.description: A diplomatic center in northeast Arcavios founded by Shadrix Silverquill where conciliators negotiate and sometimes duel.
A diplomatic center where Abigale does her field study.
A place on Arcavios with a manor, gardens and duelling stages, where ritual has kept the peace for seven hundred years.
A place for diplomacy where Shadrix, Nita and Killian work.
